description: Golden dataset for cognitive-memory retrieval and deduplication evals. Memories are stored, then each query is graded against the keys of the memories that should come back.

memories.text: The user prefers pnpm over npm for installing JavaScript dependencies.
Code in this repository is formatted with two-space indentation and single quotes by Biome.
The project owner writes in Russian and wants replies in Russian.
Pull requests must stay as drafts with auto-merge disabled until the owner reviews them.
The user likes dark mode in every editor and dashboard.
Vector search is implemented with the sqlite-vec extension loaded into better-sqlite3.
Embeddings are generated locally by Ollama with the qwen3-embedding:8b model, which outputs 4096 dimensions.
Global memories shared across projects live in ~/.cognitive-memory/global-memory.sqlite.
Continuous integration runs on GitHub Actions with Node.js 24 and pnpm 9.
The dashboard UI is a React app built with Vite and rendered as a force-directed graph.
Consolidation decays importance exponentially with lambda 0.004 per hour and deactivates memories below 0.25.
Memories whose cosine distance is at most 0.08 are merged by the local LLM during consolidation.
Memories can be exported to an Obsidian vault as Markdown notes with wikilinks.
The project is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
We decided never to send memory contents to a cloud API, to keep data private and costs at zero.
SQLite runs in WAL journal mode so the web dashboard can read while the MCP server writes.
We replaced ESLint and Prettier with Biome to have a single fast linter and formatter.
Running tsc -b rewrites tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, so revert that file before committing.
npm ci fails with an ERESOLVE peer dependency conflict; install with pnpm instead.
Tests used to write into the real global memory database in the home directory.
Eduards is the maintainer of cognitive-memory and publishes it to npm as @cemised/cognitive-memory.
Version 1.5.6 was released on 15 June 2026 with graph UX improvements.
The maintainer drinks espresso every morning before coding.
The team meetup next spring will take place in Berlin.
Резервную копию базы памяти нужно делать каждую пятницу.
Ollama слушает на порту 11434 на локальной машине.
